summary: Official Guangxi and Guigang sources establish a regional property-registration/cadastral custodian serving Guiping and identify a Guiping cadastral survey project, but no anonymous public parcel ID plus polygon response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Simplified-Chinese first-party discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-10594-guiping.json. Results identified Guigang registration procedures, Guangxi cadastral-map guidance, and a Guiping registration-data survey project.
requestOutcomes: The bounded TLS-verified direct GET to the official Guigang registration page timed out after 15 seconds; no retry, login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS disablement was used. Search-indexed first-party pages were treated as institutional evidence only. No viewer JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, safe native ID or parcel geometry response was obtained.
attemptedRoutes: Guigang Natural Resources Bureau / Real Estate Registration Center registration-file and cadastral-map procedure page
Guangxi Natural Resources Department cadastral-map inquiry guidance
Guangxi surveying association project listing naming Guiping registration-data survey and parcel-location work
